{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0 (sentinel value)
sentinel_mask = df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0
sentinel_count = sentinel_mask.sum()

# Filter out rows with sentinel values
valid_data = df[~sentinel_mask]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value on valid data
mean_valid_baseline = valid_data['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Check the updated distribution
valid_stats = valid_data['biomarker_baseline'].describe()

# Return results
(sentinel_count, mean_valid_baseline, valid_stats)"}
